title: Verify: FileStore.FrozenIDs unit tests
description: Test FrozenIDs with a temp dir.
acceptance_criteria: Given a snapshot.yaml with ids, When FrozenIDs is called, Then ids are returned with frozen=true
Given a missing snapshot or an unsafe world id, Then not-frozen without error and a non-nil error respectively

steps.action: With t.TempDir() as Root, write worlds/w/rounds/round-0000001/snapshot.yaml listing ids CON-a and CON-b in the format of round.Snapshot; assert FrozenIDs returns [CON-a CON-b], true. Then for round-0000002 without the file assert nil,false,nil. Then call with worldID "../x" and assert a non-nil error.
